column1: # Map servers this world can run (docs/operations.md, "Maps"). Hand-written from Funcom's own files; safe to publish.
# Columns, tab-separated: map (Funcom's name, as in the world_partition table and Director's [InstancingModes]),
# slot (Funcom's world-template partition id; the map's UDP ports are game 7776+slot and IGW 7887+slot), memory cap of
# its systemd scope (twice Funcom's Kubernetes limit), and the level URL put on its command line (- = the server's
# default map). URLs come from the server's DefaultGame.ini [/Script/DuneSandboxAuto.DuneSandboxAutoModuleSettings]
# m_AllowedAutomatedCommandLineLevels. Funcom's slots 33-35 (CB_Arrakis_* rooms) are left out: no URL is known for them.
